item.text: {"summary":"CUnescape sets leave_nulls_escaped to false, but CUnescapeInternal gates both octal and hexadecimal >0xff checks on that flag. The tested overflow escapes therefore pass and truncate when cast to char, contrary to the public CUnescape contract. The supplied implementation and header contract identify the cause and repair location.","hypotheses":["Octal and hexadecimal overflow checks are incorrectly conditional on leave_nulls_escaped, so CUnescape accepts values above 0xff."],"queries":[],"reads":[],"ready":true}
